Alkaloids like saponins and flavonoids like quercetin have been shown to reduce viral load and enhance immune response. The synergistic effects of these compounds contribute to the plant's overall antiviral activity. Regular consumption of Pastinaca sativa may support the body's defenses against various viral pathogens.

intro: Pastinaca sativa, commonly known as wild parsnip, offers numerous health benefits due to its rich nutritional profile. It is packed with vitamins C and K, which support immune function and bone health, respectively. The plant also contains antioxidants that help reduce inflammation and protect cells from oxidative stress, potentially lowering the risk of chronic diseases. Incorporating wild parsnip into your diet can enhance overall well-being by improving digestion, boosting energy levels, and supporting skin health through its high nutrient content.
